integrity: A complete mathematical proof and standalone standard-library checker are included; finite checks are supporting evidence and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite noncircular binary words with exactly two ones and their contiguous minimal absent factors; no general Hamming-weight bound or algorithmic speedup is asserted. The endpoint-marker witness and a linear count were previously published; priority of the new complete gap classification and generating law is subject to unindexed-literature risk.
title: Complete minimal-absent-factor spectrum for two-marker binary words
